study: promotion-gate validation on EXPLICITLY REUSED M3 data, not unseen-performance discovery
data: same M3 240 eval and24 dev inputs/answers; now known from prior measurements
candidate: M3 selected repaired implementation, no new synthesis
aggregate_gate: strict total gain, no per-task count decrease
preservation_gate: aggregate gate AND every case passed by baseline is also passed by candidate; IDs/tasks/expected values must match at every position; refusal on invalid/missing/malformed reports
control_list: M3 post-scoring None control, now preregistered for this gate study
regression-counterexample: repaired arithmetic + first_index returns 0 on nonempty input, -1 otherwise
identity baseline as equal-score rejection control
success_criterion: counterexample must have strictly higher total, equal-or-higher task scores, at least one baseline-passed case loss; aggregate accepts and preservation rejects; selected repair accepted; invalid/equal reports rejected
limits: explicit reused synthetic valid domains, no blind/unseen eval or new improvement claim
baseline-case preservation only within fixed suite, not future behavior assurance
host judge author-visible holdout; candidate worker inputs-only
git timestamps do not prove no private pre-freeze scoring
no cgroup/kernel/covert-channel guarantees; no activation authority
